pages.title: Optional Components
pages.text: None of these are required to build a working reactor. They exist for automation, remote control and looks.

pages.title: Redstone Port
pages.text: Allows control of various reactor functions via redstone circuits. A port can be configured to either read a value out of the reactor or write one into it.$(br2)Typical uses are turning the reactor on below a power threshold, driving control rod insertion from a comparator, or emitting a signal when fuel runs low.

pages.title: Computer Port
pages.text: Allows control of various reactor functions via Lua scripting. This requires a computer mod such as $(thing)CC: Tweaked$() to be installed.$(br2)Attach a computer to the port and you get the full API: activity, control rods, fuel and waste levels, temperatures, energy stored and produced.

pages.title: Reactor Glass
pages.text: Functions identically to casing, but may only be used on walls, never on the frame. It lets you see inside of the reactor.$(br2)Handy for checking that your moderator lattice looks the way you think it does.
